name: core-reconcile
description: Reconcile on a field of a table beside the Workflow field it moves, D104: an observation newer than the last moves the status along the fewest transitions its Workflow allows, each through Workflow's transition as the observer, so other uses' guards hold each step and a refused step records drift; an older one changes nothing; staleAfterMs arms a deadline that moves a row no observation reached to unreachable; with each one's define refusals. Its Workflow and Reconcile are anchored on fields (a behavior entry's field). Cases written by hand in the recorded format, since no engine implements Reconcile. Each answer holds what the replayer compares: a record's id, data and behaviors, an operation's result, and a refusal whole, in the core's words; what only the engine's store answers (sequence numbers, versions, timestamps, the document a define echoes) is left out.

scenarios.name: Reconcile > a step the observer may not make stops the path and records drift, an observation the path reaches clears it, and with no path from a terminal state the drift is no_path

Reconcile > other uses' guards hold each step: StateRules' missing_fields and another principal's active lease, the observe itself listed in Lease's exempt, record drift, and the holder's own observation moves the row

Reconcile > staleAfterMs arms a deadline from each observation's at; a newer observation moves it, its fire, as the runner, moves the row to unreachable along the fewest transitions and records it as observed, and a newer observation moves it back
Reconcile > a stale move a guard vetoes records drift, and the deadline is spent: the row stays until a newer observation
